items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Names and doc comments are mostly clear, but there is single-letter business logic (`k := make([]byte, KeySize)`) and the UnmarshalYAML helper fields are cryptic (`KeySource2`, `KeySource3`, `KeyEnvVar2`, `KeyFile3`).

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Dead `func (job Job) validate() error { return job.Validate() }` was left in. An unrequested UnmarshalYAML alias layer was added. The four switch cases repeat the same exclusivity block. save() validates twice: Validate(), then LoadKey runs validateSourceAndFields again.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: Chunk length bounds are checked, HMAC uses hmac.Equal, truncation errors at every read, the key is copied defensively, Close is idempotent, write-after-close returns an error, and key errors wrap ErrInvalidKey. Minor: some causes are formatted with %v, not %w.

items.name: Interface changes limited to the specified ones
items.name_zh: 接口变更仅限题目要求
items.evidence: EnsureFileSuffix/EnsureFileName gained shouldEncrypt before unique, and all callers were updated. storage.PathGenerator keeps its signature and passes false. Unencrypted output and filenames are unchanged, and only Validate/Encryption/storageReadWriteCloser were added on existing types.
